# Granny Obsidian vault settings

The `docs/` directory is the Granny Obsidian vault. Open
`/home/lgtw/Work/granny/docs` in Obsidian.

Obsidian's generated JSON, workspace layout, plugins, themes, cache, and trash
are local state and are ignored by Git. No community plugin is required.

Recommended core features are File Explorer, Search, Backlinks, Outgoing Links,
Properties, Templates, Outline, Graph, and File Recovery. Configure `_templates`
as the core Templates folder if desired. Daily Notes may be enabled for personal
use but are not part of Granny's canonical project workflow.
